topic.label: Cryptocurrencies and Digital Assets
topic.desc: Digital money and assets: blockchains and consensus, cryptocurrencies and tokens, wallets and custody, crypto exchanges and DeFi, stablecoins and central bank digital currencies, and crypto regulation.

concepts: How blockchains work: blocks, consensus (proof of work, proof of stake), nodes and smart contracts.
Bitcoin, Ether, tokens, token standards, supply schedules and tokenomics.
Wallets, private keys, seed phrases, self custody versus custodians, and security.
Centralized exchanges, decentralized exchanges, liquidity pools, lending and their risks.
Stablecoins and Central Bank Digital Currencies
Fiat-backed and algorithmic stablecoins, reserves, and central bank digital currencies.
How crypto is regulated and taxed by jurisdiction: securities status, licensing, travel rule and reporting.
skills: Explains how a blockchain records and confirms transactions and its trust assumptions.
Analyzes a token's supply, distribution, utility and risks.
Compares self custody, hardware wallets and custodians by risk and control.
Reviews a DeFi protocol's smart contract, liquidity and counterparty risks.
Explains a stablecoin's peg mechanism and how its reserves are attested.
Maps how a crypto activity is regulated in a jurisdiction and what must be reported.
mcp: CCXT MCP server: cryptocurrency exchange market data, tickers, order books, trades and accounts across many crypto exchanges.
Coinbase AgentKit: onchain wallets, token transfers, swaps and smart contract actions on crypto blockchains, with an MCP extension.
